Reason for Mistake: The agent attempted to download the full text of the book using a `curl` command to a Project MUSE landing page URL (`https://muse.jhu.edu/book/24372`). This URL is a metadata and access gateway page, not a direct link to the full text file (PDF or HTML). Consequently, the `curl` command only retrieved the HTML source code of the landing page (7965 bytes), which does not contain the chapter content needed to answer the question. The agent failed to correctly identify the specific URL pattern required to access the full text or to realize that the landing page does not contain the raw text, leading to an inability to extract the answer from Chapter 2.
